findings.failure_path: A round branch changes reviewed content, installs a validator that accepts fabricated evidence, and is automatically merged. A later legitimate round restores the validator. Promotion cannot use one aggregate ledger, so chain binding checks the malicious historical round inside its own checkout; its forged validator accepts, automatic-tree equality and filename coverage pass, and unreviewed bytes reach the target.
findings.smallest_fix: Do not establish round validity solely with code from the round head. Require a trusted CI attestation binding the first parent, second parent, candidate hash, and approved controller/validator digest, or validate with tooling anchored in a trusted target revision.

findings.failure_path: For a valid chain containing exactly 64 non-base steps, the loop processes the 64th step and sets commit to the base, then exits without checking ancestry again and raises the “more than 64 steps” error.
findings.smallest_fix: After the loop, return the collected steps if commit is now an ancestor of base_tip; add tests proving 64 steps pass and 65 fail.

findings.failure_path: If git worktree remove fails, its result is discarded. Prune runs while the directory still exists, then rmtree deletes it, potentially leaving a registered stale or locked worktree while the gate still reports success.
findings.smallest_fix: Check cleanup command results, remove the directory before a final prune when necessary, verify the registration is gone, and fail closed if cleanup cannot be completed.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: The chain can accept unreviewed content because each historical round is validated using the controller and validator supplied by that round’s second parent, without trusted attestation that the round actually passed an independent gate.
Boundary containment is incomplete: an exactly 64-step valid chain is rejected, and worktree cleanup failures are silently ignored, allowing successful runs to leave stale registrations.

challenge_focus: Bypass the new first-parent chain accept path: construct a promotion HEAD whose every step passes the automatic-merge tree equality and the sync/round classification yet lands content no round reviewed (evil second parents, merges of ancestors, re-merged old heads, octopus or shallow histories, a round whose evidence directory or validator is forged inside its own branch), abuse of the detached temporary checkout (path, cleanup, symlinks, untracked files, concurrent runs), and any way the name-level coverage check or the sync classification can be satisfied while unreviewed bytes reach the target.
